title: GetCreativeFeaturesSuccess
description: Terminal success response. evaluation_id is the provider-side reconciliation identity allocated when the evaluation was accepted and remains stable across exact replays and asynchronous completion.

evaluation_id.description: Provider-generated identity for this evaluation. Stable across exact response replays and, for async work, identical to the evaluation_id returned on the submitted acknowledgement. Used for result provenance, consumption and provider-cost reconciliation, and support; it is not an idempotency key or task identity.

results.description: Feature values for the evaluated creative

detail_url.description: URL to the vendor's full assessment report. The vendor controls what information is disclosed and access control.

audit_observations.description: Non-blocking audit observations from the governance agent. Observations surface audit-worthy claims that are not verifier refutations and are not rejection grounds by themselves.

pricing_option_id.description: Which rate card pricing option was applied for this evaluation. Present when the governance agent charges for evaluations and account was provided in the request.

vendor_cost.description: Cost incurred for this evaluation, denominated in currency.

consumption.description: Structured consumption details for this evaluation. Informational — lets the buyer verify that vendor_cost is consistent with the rate card. vendor_cost is the billing source of truth.
